source: A druid approaches you. "Will you help save our world?"
translation: 一位德鲁伊走到你面前。“你愿意帮助拯救我们的世界吗？”

source: After some reflection, you decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth the effort of clearing out the current occupants of the $(poi_1). (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 思量一番后，你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你费力清除 $(poi_1) 里如今的住民。（当地声望 -2）

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear out all enemies in the $(poi_1) and report back.
translation: 清除 $(poi_1) 内的所有敌人，然后回来复命。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Return to town and report your success in clearing the $(poi_1).
translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除 $(poi_1) 内的敌人。

source: Room for New Growth
translation: 为新生腾出空间

source: Stunned, the Druid watches you leave. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 德鲁伊愣住了，目送你离开。（当地声望 -1）

source: The druid frowns slightly, but hands you a bundle wrapped in small vines. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 德鲁伊微微皱眉，还是递给你一个用细藤捆好的包裹。（当地声望 -1）

source: The druid hands you a bundle wrapped in small vines.
translation: 德鲁伊递给你一个用细藤捆好的包裹。

source: The druid keeps a passive look on her face. "Soon those things will be balanced as well." (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 德鲁伊神色平静。“那些事很快也会归于平衡。”（当地声望 -1）

source: The druid shakes her head. "Most of them, but they are not your direct concern."
translation: 德鲁伊摇摇头。“大多数都需要，但你要处理的不是它们。”

source: The druids face remains unchanged, but her voice grows a touch more quiet. "The forest will remember this." (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 德鲁伊神色未变，声音却低了些。“森林会记住这件事。”（当地声望 -1）

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Travel to the $(poi_1) and defeat all enemies inside. The target location is in the Forest biome.
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于森林地区。

source: What do you think I'm trying to do? (Decline Quest)
translation: “不然你以为我在忙什么？”（拒绝任务）

source: You nod. "As it should be."
translation: 你点点头。“本该如此。”

source: You return to town, and find the druid waiting for you just outside of it. "Balance has been restored." (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 回到镇上时，你发现德鲁伊已在城外等候。“平衡已经恢复。”（当地声望 +3）

source: "And why exactly do you need me?"
translation: “那为什么非得找我？”

source: "Capable and in a hurry." You brush past him and continue on your way. (Decline Quest)
translation: “能干，但也赶时间。”你从他身边走过，继续赶路。（拒绝任务）

source: "Capable just so happens to be my middle name."
translation: “能干？那可是我的招牌。”

source: "Fine, fine... I hope you've got something in that wagon to make it worth my while." You make note of the location and set off to clear it. (Accept Quest)
translation: “好吧，好吧……但愿你车上的东西值得我跑这一趟。”你记下地点，动身前去清剿。（接受任务）

source: "I don't think I'm interested. Sorry." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，我没兴趣。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I see. And I suppose you're looking for the current occupants to be removed?
translation: “明白了。你是想让我把现在的住户请出去？”

source: "Well then, I hope your new settlement will remember me fondly when setting prices." You make note of the location and promise to clear it out. (Accept Quest)
translation: “那你们的新聚落定价时，可得记着我的好。”你记下地点，答应清除那里的敌人。（接受任务）

source: "Well, because I'm no good in a fight while I'm protecting my belongings!" He glances back at the cart once again.
translation: “我忙着保护财物的时候，可没法好好打架！”他又回头看了一眼货车。

source: "Well, some folks here in town are looking to move on, start fresh somewhere new. We had a spot picked out to settle down, but... it appears to be occupied."
translation: “镇上有些人想搬走，换个地方重新开始。落脚的地方已经选好了，可是……似乎已经有人住了。”

source: "Yes! Exactly that! After all, I have this deed right here stating that we own the land!" He briefly flashes some papers, but you notice some of the ink has smeared ink on them.
translation: “对！正是如此！毕竟，我手上可是有地契，证明这片地归我们所有！”他晃了晃几张纸，你却注意到上面有些墨迹已经蹭花。

source: "You might want to spend some time cleaning it before you move in, but it's all yours." (Complete Quest)
translation: “搬进去之前，你可能还得好好打扫一番。不过地方归你了。”（完成任务）

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: As soon as you turn to head back to town, you hear the squeaking of wagon wheels in the distance. Your employer comes into view, and drives his wagon right up to you.
translation: 你刚转身准备回镇，远处便传来车轮的吱呀声。雇主驾着马车出现，径直停在你面前。

source: As you approach the town square, a man climbs down from a packed wagon. He glances around, then walks toward you. "You there, you look like a capable individual!"
translation: 你走近镇中心的广场时，一个男人从装满行李的货车上爬下来。他四下张望，随后朝你走来。“嘿，看你就是个能干的人！”

source: Business? What sort of business?
translation: “什么事？”

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear all enemies from a dungeon.
translation: 清除地城中的所有敌人。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Eviction Notice
translation: 逐客令

source: Exit the newly cleared (but not yet cleaned) dungeon.
translation: 离开刚刚清剿完毕、却还没来得及打扫的地城。

source: He looks perplexed for a moment, but glances back at the wagon as though distracted by it. "I was hoping you could handle some business for me."
translation: 他一时有些困惑，又分心似的回头看了看货车。“有件事，希望你能替我办妥。”

source: Leave
translation: 离开

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Travel to the $(poi_1) and defeat all enemies inside.
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。

source: You decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth clearing out the current occupants of the $(poi_1). They were here first anyway. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你清除 $(poi_1) 现有的居民。毕竟，是他们先来的。（当地声望 -2）

source: "Ah, there's the catch. No thanks." (Decline Quest)
translation: “果然没那么简单。免了吧。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Consider it done." (Accept Quest)
translation: “交给我吧。”（接受任务）

source: "Good. I just need you to clear the current occupants of the area I'd like to plant. They've been bothering our farm anyway."
translation: “好。我要种地的那片地方，你把现在占着的家伙清理掉就行。反正他们也一直在骚扰农场。”

source: "That doesn't seem to be my problem." (Decline Quest)
translation: “这好像不关我的事。”（拒绝任务）

source: "They'll be fertilizing your grain in no time." (Accept Quest)
translation: “用不了多久，他们就能给你的庄稼当肥料了。”（接受任务）

source: "We need a new field to increase our harvest." A weathered but intimidating man in simple farmer's garb addresses you directly. "This town is growing faster than my grain."
translation: “我们需要新田地，才能多收粮食。”一个穿着朴素农装、饱经风霜却很有威势的男人直截了当地对你说，“这镇子长得比我的庄稼还快。”

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: A Freshly Plowed Field
translation: 新垦之田

source: A man of few words, but he pays well enough. (Complete Quest)
translation: 人虽然话不多，报酬倒还不错。（完成任务）

source: A no-nonsense man deserves a no-nonsense reply. "I can handle that."
translation: 对爽快人就说爽快话。“我来办。”

source: After some reflection, you decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth the effort of clearing out the current occupants of the $(poi_2). (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 思量一番后，你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你费力清除 $(poi_2) 里如今的住民。（当地声望 -2）

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear out all enemies in the $(poi_2) and report back.
translation: 清除 $(poi_2) 内的所有敌人，然后回来复命。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: He shrugs and moves on. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他耸耸肩，走开了。（当地声望 -1）

source: Leave
translation: 出城

source: Leave town to begin your quest.
translation: 离开城镇，开始任务。

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Travel to the $(poi_1) and defeat all enemies inside. The target location is in the Plains biome.
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于平原地区。

source: You've barely finished clearing the area, and the imposing farmer is already preparing to harness one of his animals to a plow outside. Seeing you approach, he tosses you a satchel. "Thanks." He then gets back to work.
translation: 你才刚把这片地方清理干净，那位气势逼人的农夫就已在外面准备给牲口套犁。见你走来，他扔给你一个挎包。“谢了。”说罢，又埋头干起活来。

source: "No questions. Just listen." He puts a small satchel in your hands. "Take this compass. Follow it, and remove anything it points to. When it no longer points, return to me."
translation: “别问，只管听。”他把一个小袋子塞进你手里。“拿上这只罗盘。顺着它走，把它指向的东西清除掉。等它不再指路，就回来找我。”

source: "That's more like it." (+1 Local Reputation)
translation: “这还差不多。”（当地声望 +1）

source: "What do you need?"
translation: “你需要什么？”

source: "You. Come here." The gnome speaking to you seems very out of place here. He wears a white pristine robe that was either a shirt or custom tailored for him. He acts like he belongs and that he owns the place, however.
translation: “你，过来。”招呼你的地侏看起来与此地格格不入。他穿着一件洁白无瑕的长袍，不知是件衬衣，还是专门量身裁制的。不过看他的派头，不仅自在得很，简直像这里的主人。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Another gnome, slightly taller than the first but not dressed as finely, meets you at the gate. "The compass, if you please."
translation: 另一个地侏在城门口迎上你。他略高一些，衣着却没先前那位考究。“劳驾，把罗盘给我。”

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear out all enemies in the $(poi_2) and report back.
translation: 清除 $(poi_2) 内的所有敌人，然后回来复命。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Despite the insistence of the needle you decide that you will not finish clearing the $(poi_2). As if it could sense this somehow, the onyx compass disappears. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 尽管指针执意指路，你还是决定不再清剿 $(poi_2)。黑玛瑙罗盘仿佛察觉到了你的心意，凭空消失了。（当地声望 -2）

source: Got it. (Accept Quest)
translation: “明白了。”（接受任务）

source: He scowls and stomps away, one tiny step at a time. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他阴沉着脸，迈着小碎步气冲冲地走了。（当地声望 -1）

source: He snatches up the cloth sack and walks away, cursing you the whole way. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他一把抓起布袋，骂骂咧咧地走了，一路都没停。（当地声望 -1）

source: Leave
translation: 出城

source: Leave town to begin your quest.
translation: 离开城镇，开始任务。

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Return to town and report your success in clearing the $(poi_2).
translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除 $(poi_2) 内的敌人。

source: The 'compass' is unlike most you have ever seen before. There is not a single marking on it anywhere, nor any color other than onyx save the crimson needle.
translation: 这只“罗盘”和你以往见过的大不相同。上面没有任何刻度或标记，除那根深红的指针外，通体都是玛瑙般的黑色。

source: The gnome demands your attention again before you can investigate. "Are you deaf and dumb, or just dumb? GET MOVING!!!" (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 还没等你细看，地侏又把你的注意力拽了回去。“你又聋又傻，还是光傻？还不快走！！！”（当地声望 -1）

source: The gnome gives a satisfied grunt, and continues to issue orders. He puts a small satchel in your hands "Here. Take this compass. Follow it, and remove anything it points to. When it no longer points, return to me."
translation: 地侏满意地哼了一声，继续发号施令。他把一个小袋子塞进你手里。“拿着。这是罗盘。顺着它走，把它指向的东西清除掉。等它不再指路，就回来找我。”

source: The joke goes over his head.
translation: 他没听出你话里的打趣。

source: The needle points unerringly in a single direction, no matter which way or how quickly you turn the device. You reach out and touch it, and find that you are unable to move the needle yourself.
translation: 无论你朝哪个方向转动罗盘、转得多快，指针都稳稳指向同一个方向。你伸手碰了碰它，发现根本拨不动。

source: The Onyx Compass
translation: 黑玛瑙罗盘

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Travel to the $(poi_2) and defeat all enemies inside. The target location is in the Swamp Biome.
translation: 前往 $(poi_2)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于沼泽地区。

source: Walk over without a word.
translation: 一言不发地走过去。

source: You can't resist slipping one thing in: "Understood. I'll be back shortly." (Accept Quest)
translation: 你还是忍不住贫了一句：“明白。这点小事，我去去就回。”（接受任务）

source: You check your compass, looking for your next target, only to find that the needle has disappeared entirely. Your task appears to be complete.
translation: 你查看罗盘，想寻找下一个目标，却发现指针已经彻底消失。看来任务完成了。

source: You drop the satchel. "What?" (Decline Quest)
translation: 你丢下袋子。“你说什么？”（拒绝任务）

source: You glance down at the satchel, surprised at its weight.
translation: 你低头看了看袋子，没想到它这么沉。

source: You hand it over in its satchel, and he gives you a larger yet seemingly lighter bag in return. (Complete Quest)
translation: 你把装着罗盘的袋子交给他，他则回赠了一个更大、却似乎更轻的袋子。（完成任务）

source: You hold out your hand. "Sorry, must be this tall to give orders" (Decline Quest)
translation: 你伸手比了个高度。“抱歉，发号施令得有这么高。”（拒绝任务）

source: You look back up (slightly) to meet his glare. "Understood, sir." (Accept Quest)
translation: 你稍稍抬起目光，迎上他的瞪视。“明白，长官。”（接受任务）

source: You look closer at the needle.
translation: 再仔细看看指针。

source: You put the compass away and carry on. (Continue)
translation: 你收起罗盘，继续赶路。（继续）

source: You retrieve the compass from its pouch as you approach the town's gate. It is made of a deeply dark stone, with a single red needle that indicates where to find your targets.
translation: 走近城门时，你从袋中取出罗盘。它由漆黑的石头制成，只有一根红色指针，指示着目标的方向。

source: You take a closer look at the device.
translation: 仔细看看这件器具。

source: You take note of the direction and head off that way, putting the device away for now. (Continue)
translation: 你记下方向，朝那边动身，暂且收起罗盘。（继续）

source: "A fight with a dragon? I look forward to the challenge!"
translation: “和龙打一场？这挑战我很期待！”

source: "A fight with a dragon? No thanks. I'll be leaving now." (Decline Quest)
translation: “和龙打一场？不了，谢谢。我这就走。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Before it comes here, the dragon will attempt to make a home at a $(poi_1) nearby. It will find several unfriendly occupants already there. But if you were to remove them in advance, I believe the creature will nest there and spare our village."
translation: “来这里之前，那头龙会先去附近的 $(poi_1) 筑巢。但那里已有一些不好惹的住户。如果你先除掉他们，我想那头龙就会留在那里，放过我们的村子。”

source: "Fight off all the creatures in a $(poi_1) and then a dragon too? No thanks. (Decline Quest)
translation: “先打倒 $(poi_1) 里所有的生物，再打一条龙？免了吧。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Going somewhere?"
translation: “您这是要去哪儿？”

source: "How do we do that?"
translation: “那该怎么做？”

source: "I don't think I'm interested. Sorry." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，我没兴趣。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I'll take my chances, thanks." (Decline Quest)
translation: “我还是赌一把吧，谢谢。”（拒绝任务）

source: "My vision was less than specific about whether or not it would be changed by your actions. So... yes."
translation: “我的异象可没说清楚，你的行动究竟能不能改变结局。所以……是的，我要走了。”

source: "No." He shakes his head. "But I have had a vision. A vision of destruction, fire, and ruin. And of you."
translation: “不认识。”他摇摇头，“但我看到了异象。毁灭、烈火、废墟。还有你。”

source: "Point the way." (Accept Quest)
translation: “指个方向吧。”（接受任务）

source: "Tell me more about this vision, elder."
translation: “长者，再跟我说说那个异象。”

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (continue)
translation: （继续）

source: A Vision of Destruction
translation: 毁灭的预兆

source: After some reflection, you decide to abandon clearing out $(poi_1). The villagers will be fine, right? (-3 Local Reputation)
translation: 思量一番后，你决定放弃清剿 $(poi_1)。村民们应该不会有事吧？（当地声望 -3）

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear out all enemies in the $(poi_1) and report back.
translation: 清除 $(poi_1) 内的所有敌人，然后回来复命。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: He continues with great urgency. "A spawn of Lathliss seeks a new home, and will come here soon unless we intervene." (+1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他语气急切：“拉黎丝的一头后裔正在寻找新巢。再不阻止，它很快就会来到这里。”（当地声望 +1）

source: He exclaims at you as you walk by. "Leave. NOW!!! You must leave!!!" (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你走过时，他冲你大喊：“离开！马上！！！你必须离开！！！”（当地声望 -2）

source: He scowls at you and continues. "This is no laughing matter. A spawn of Lathliss seeks a new home, and will come here soon unless we intervene." (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他瞪了你一眼，接着说道：“这不是玩笑。拉黎丝的一头后裔正在寻找新巢。再不阻止，它很快就会来到这里。”（当地声望 -1）

source: He shakes his head. "It is a fight that you would win. But in the process, our village would be lost. We MUST prevent the beast from arriving."
translation: 他摇摇头。“你会赢。但在战斗中，我们的村子也会毁掉。绝不能让那头巨兽来到这里。”

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Return to town and report your success in clearing the $(poi_1).
translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除 $(poi_1) 内的敌人。

source: The $(poi_1) falls silent as you remove the last creature. You consider staying to welcome the dragon, should it appear, but something tells you that leaving would be a much better idea for now.
translation: 清除了最后一个生物后，$(poi_1) 归于寂静。你想过留下来迎接那头可能现身的龙，但直觉告诉你，现在离开才是明智之举。

source: The elder meets you outside the gates of the village as you return, mounted on horseback. He hands you a pouch containing your rewards. (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 你返回村子时，长者骑着马在村门外迎上来，递给你一个装着报酬的袋子。（当地声望 +3）

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Travel to the $(poi_1) and defeat all enemies inside. The target location is in the Mountain biome.
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于山脉地区。

source: Walking into the village, an old man looks up as if expecting you and rushes over (to the extent that he is able) "$(playername). I need you to turn around and leave. NOW."
translation: 你走进村子时，一位老人抬起头，仿佛早就在等你。他尽力快步迎上来：“$(playername)，你得转身离开。马上。”

source: You give a wry grin. "I was under the impression that destruction, fire, and ruin were popular hobbies around here."
translation: 你苦笑道：“我还以为，毁灭、烈火和废墟是这一带流行的消遣呢。”

source: You glance around at a clear sky warily before going on into town. (Complete Quest)
translation: 你警惕地扫了一眼晴朗的天空，这才继续走进镇子。（完成任务）

source: You take a good look at the old man, but do not recognize his features. "Should I know you?"
translation: 你仔细打量老人，却认不出他的面孔。“我们认识吗？”

source: "And what do these anonymous nobles desire?"
translation: “这些不愿透露身份的贵族想要什么？”

source: "Consider it done." (Accept Quest)
translation: “交给我吧。”（接受任务）

source: "Excuse me, adventurer, but I'm in need of assistance." The man appears of modest means at first glance, but a closer inspection reveals that his average looking clothing is may as well be made for a king.
translation: “打扰了，冒险者。我需要一些帮助。”乍看之下，这个男人家境平常；仔细一瞧，他那身不起眼的衣服，用料做工却连国王也穿得。

source: "I don't like not knowing who I am working for"
translation: “我不喜欢连雇主是谁都不知道。”

source: "I don't think I'm interested. Sorry." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，我没兴趣。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I must decline. I respect the local inhabitants far more than faceless nobility." (Decline Quest)
translation: “恕我拒绝。比起不肯露面的贵族，我更尊重当地住民。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I see. And I suppose you're looking for the current occupants to be removed?"
translation: “明白了。你是想让我把现在的住户请出去？”

source: "My lieges wish for a private island location for a vacation, far from prying eyes and ears. I wish for you to make certain that it will be clear for them."
translation: “我的主人想找座私人岛屿度假，远离窥探和窃听。我希望你确保那里没有人打扰。”

source: "Of course, what can I do for you?"
translation: “当然，需要我做什么？”

source: "Precisely. Do so, and you will be well rewarded.
translation: “正是如此。办妥之后，自有厚报。”

source: "Sorry, but knowing your name is not knowing you. I'm not interested." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，知道名字可不等于了解你。我没兴趣。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Sorry, that sounds like more than I have time for at the moment." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，这活儿恐怕比我眼下能抽出的时间多。”（拒绝任务）

source: "To remain anonymous. And to take an island vacation. I have identified a spot which meets all of their requirements, but it is currently occupied."
translation: “不透露身份。还有，去岛上度假。我已经找到一处符合所有要求的地方，可惜目前有人占着。”

source: "Very well, Lazarus, what can I do for you?"
translation: “好吧，拉撒路。需要我做什么？”

source: "Well I've always wanted to be owed a favor from the rich and powerful. I'll do it." (Accept Quest)
translation: “我一直想让权贵欠个人情。这活儿我接了。”（接受任务）

source: "You know me, and you will work for me."
translation: “你知道我是谁，而你是为我工作。”

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Complete Quest)
translation: （完成任务）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: A Private Island
translation: 私人岛屿

source: After some reflection, you decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth the effort of clearing out the current occupants of the $(poi_1). (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 思量一番后，你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你费力清除 $(poi_1) 里如今的住民。（当地声望 -2）

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear out all enemies in the $(poi_1) and report back.
translation: 清除 $(poi_1) 内的所有敌人，然后回来复命。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: He bows to you slightly. "My name is Lazarus, a humble servant of nobles who wish to remain anonymous."
translation: 他向你微微欠身。“我叫拉撒路，是几位不愿透露身份的贵族的卑微仆从。”

source: He gives you the smallest bow imaginable, just enough to say that one was given, without indicating respect.
translation: 他几乎只是点了点头，勉强算得上行礼，却看不出半分敬意。

source: He gives you the smallest bow imaginable, just enough to say that one was given, without indicating respect. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他几乎只是点了点头，勉强算得上行礼，却看不出半分敬意。（当地声望 -1）

source: He simply nods and walks away in search of someone else to aid him.
translation: 他只是点点头，转身去找其他帮手。

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Return to town and report your success in clearing the $(poi_1).
translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除 $(poi_1) 内的敌人。

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Travel to the $(poi_1) and defeat all enemies inside. The target location is in the Island biome.
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于海岛地区。

source: With gentrification of the area on the behalf of nobility complete, you console your conscience with the rewards that materialize in front of you.
translation: 替贵族把当地住民清理完毕后，你看着眼前凭空出现的报酬，勉强安抚了一下良心。

source: You can't put your finger on it, but something seems off about the man. "This isn't a good time." (Decline Quest)
translation: 你说不上来，可总觉得这人有些不对劲。“现在不方便。”（拒绝任务）

source: "And why exactly do you need me?"
translation: “那为什么非得找我？”

source: "Can I help you?"
translation: “有什么需要帮忙的吗？”

source: "I don't think I'm interested. Sorry." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，我没兴趣。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I see." You think you know where this is headed.
translation: “明白了。”你大概猜到了下文。

source: "I'll do it. But I hope the dearly departed left you something else of value." (Accept Quest)
translation: “我接了。但愿那位逝者还给你留了些别的值钱东西。”（接受任务）

source: "I've come into an inheritance of a small estate that I've been expecting for years. Recently, I've had some hard times, and I've convinced some individuals to let me borrow against the land."
translation: “我等了好些年，最近终于继承了一小片庄园。前阵子日子不好过，我说服了几个人，让他们接受这片地作抵押，借了些钱。”

source: "If you're not settling there, I suggest you sell the land quickly before anyone else moves in." (Complete Quest)
translation: “要是不打算自己住，最好趁别人搬进去之前，赶紧把地卖了。”（完成任务）

source: "So long as I get to keep whatever I find along the way too." (Accept Quest).
translation: “可以，但路上找到的东西也归我。”（接受任务）

source: "Well, it seems the land isn't empty, and I need someone to fix that. You look like the sort that could handle it."
translation: “嗯，那块地似乎不是空的，我需要有人解决这个问题。看起来你能办到。”

source: "You have the wrong person. I promise you that." (Decline Quest)
translation: “你找错人了。我保证。”（拒绝任务）

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: A few other people in the inn stop and look, but the man walks away without making a scene. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 旅店里几个人停下来望了过来，但那个男人没有闹事，默默走开了。（当地声望 -1）

source: As you introduce yourself to the inside of the local inn for the night, another patron approaches you.
translation: 你走进当地旅店，准备留宿一晚。这时，另一位客人朝你走来。

source: Clear
translation: 清剿

source: Clear out all enemies in the $(poi_1)and report back.
translation: 清除 $(poi_1) 内的所有敌人，然后回来复命。

source: Clearing the ledger
translation: 清账

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: He nods. "I hope so. You have the air of a powerful sorcerer, and I'm hoping that means that you can."
translation: 他点点头。“但愿如此。你有股强大法师的气势，我希望这意味着你能帮得上忙。”

source: Mana Shards, Uncommon & Rare cards
translation: 法术力碎片、非普通及稀有牌

source: Return to town and report your success in clearing the $(poi_1).
translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除 $(poi_1) 内的敌人。

source: The man looks sheepish. "Unfortunately, I found that the land isn't exactly usable at the moment. Because it's occupied. Would you be willing to clear it for me in exchange for other parts of the inheritance?"
translation: 男人有些窘迫。“可惜，那块地现在不太能用，因为有人占着。你愿意替我清理掉他们吗？我可以把遗产中的其他东西给你作报酬。”

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Travel to the $(poi_1) and defeat all enemies inside. The target location is in the Wasteland biome.
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于荒地地区。

source: True to his word, the man provides you with a reward from his inheritance. It's worth far less than the land (now that it's been cleared), but it's still valuable in addition to what loot you already recovered in the $(poi_1).
translation: 男人信守承诺，从遗产中拿出一份报酬交给你。它远不如清理完的土地值钱，不过算上你在 $(poi_1) 找到的战利品，仍是一笔不错的收获。

source: You decide not to clear out the $(poi_1). Surely your client's creditors will understand. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你决定不再清剿 $(poi_1)。想必雇主的债主会体谅的吧。（当地声望 -2）

source: You wait for him to continue.
translation: 等他继续说下去。

source: "{COLOR=red}Have fangs, will travel{ENDCOLOR}".
translation: “{COLOR=red}利齿在口，天涯可赴{ENDCOLOR}”。

source: "$(playername): Please harvest at least three $(enemy_1) and bring them to the tavern on a Tuesday."
translation: “$(playername)：请收集至少三具 $(enemy_1)，并于周二送到酒馆。”

source: "I'll file that away under things that make sense yet don't." (Decline Quest)
translation: “这可真是既说得通、又说不通。我记下了。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Nope. Nope nope nope..." You drop the paper and walk away, casting a small spell to cause the letter to fall apart and blow away on the wind. (Decline Quest)
translation: “不行，不行不行不行……”你丢下纸，转身离开，顺手施了个小法术，让纸张碎裂，随风飘散。（拒绝任务）

source: "One?" You pull on the nail but it is firmly embedded, so you rip the paper off of it instead.
translation: “一份？”你拔了拔钉子，发现钉得很牢，便把纸从钉子上撕了下来。

source: "Well that's not weird at all. Why not?" (Accept Quest)
translation: “嗯，一点都不古怪。何乐而不为呢？”（接受任务）

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: $(enemy_1)s and a few random creatures are filling most of one cart, while the other holds a few identical satchels of goods.
translation: 一辆车大半装着 $(enemy_1) 和零星其他生物，另一辆则放着几个一模一样的货袋。

source: 3 $(enemy_1)s are proving to be too much trouble to be worth your time, whether your mysterious client knows your name or not. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 不管那位神秘雇主知不知道你的名字，收集 3 个 $(enemy_1) 都太麻烦，不值得再花时间。（当地声望 -2）

source: A folded piece of paper is nailed to the board.
translation: 告示板上钉着一张折起来的纸。

source: A job board has been constructed outside the local inn, and you see that it is covered in various papers and posters.
translation: 当地旅店外立着一块委托告示板，上面贴满了各式纸张和海报。

source: A short note is written in red ink.
translation: 一张短笺上写着红色字迹。

source: Bone Collector
translation: 拾骨者

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat $(enemy_1)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_1)

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。

source: Gold and Mana Shards
translation: 金币和法术力碎片

source: It reads: "Gimgee's self-replicating paper. When you need unlimited paper or to clear a forest from afar, it's got to be Gimgee's."
translation: 上面写着：“金吉自动复制纸。无论您需要无穷无尽的纸张，还是想远程砍光一片森林，认准金吉就对了。”

source: Most of the ads are nondescript, weather worn, or written in an unfamiliar language. A few catch your eye, however.
translation: 大多数告示不是平平无奇，就是饱经风吹日晒，或是用你不认识的语言写成。不过，还是有几张引起了你的注意。

source: Return to where the quest began to turn in the reagents and collect your rewards.
translation: 回到接取任务的地方，交付材料并领取报酬。

source: Something isn't right about this, so you walk away instead. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你觉得哪里不对，决定转身离开。（拒绝任务）

source: Sometimes it pays to specialize. Cash in on a local bounty by bringing in the remains of 3 $(enemy_1)s. They can usually be found in the Swamp biome.
translation: 专精一种猎物，有时也能赚钱。带回 3 个 $(enemy_1) 的遗骸，领取当地赏金。通常可在沼泽地区找到它们。

source: Sure enough, a necromancer stands outside the inn with two wagons behind him, he is obviously your contact.
translation: 果然，一个死灵术士站在旅店外，身后停着两辆货车。显然，他就是接头人。

source: The pale skinned man speaks with a crackling voice, but the words seem reflexive to him at this point. "Place them there. Take one package."
translation: 那人皮肤苍白，声音嘶哑，说话仿佛只是机械重复：“放在那边。拿一包走。”

source: The visible portion says 'Take one' in clear and measured handwriting.
translation: 露在外面的部分，字迹工整地写着：“请取一份。”

source: This is just weird. You drop the paper and leave. (Decline Quest)
translation: 太古怪了。你丢下纸，转身离开。（拒绝任务）

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Turn your attention to the carts' attendant.
translation: 转头看向看车的人。

source: Undeterred and intrigued, you open the paper and begin to read.
translation: 你好奇心更盛，毫不退缩地展开纸，读了起来。

source: With the necessary $(enemy_1)s handled, it's time to go collect your rewards. (Don't forget you can track the quest to get directions back to town)
translation: 需要的 $(enemy_1) 已经解决，该去领取报酬了。（别忘了，可以追踪任务来查看返回城镇的路线。）

source: You could swear it wasn't there before, but an identical copy remains as you pull down the note.
translation: 你敢肯定刚才那里没有别的纸，可你取下这张后，一张一模一样的副本仍留在原处。

source: You dump the $(enemy_1s) and collect your rewards. (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 你放下 $(enemy_1s)，领到了报酬。（当地声望 +3）

source: You dump the $(enemy_1s) on to one of the wagons and collect your rewards. (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 你把 $(enemy_1s) 倒在一辆马车上，领到了报酬。（当地声望 +3）

source: You feel awkward pulling your $(enemy_1)s into town, but it doesn't actually seem that out of place here with other macabre scenes around. (This quest will only given in black biome in the future).
translation: 拖着这些 $(enemy_1) 进城，让你觉得有些尴尬。不过看看周围的种种阴森景象，这一幕倒也不算突兀。（此任务今后将仅在黑色地区提供。）

source: You look around for someone that seems to be expecting bodies.
translation: 四下寻找像是在等着收尸的人。

source: You look at what seems to be an advertisement of some sort off to one side.
translation: 你望向一旁，那里似乎贴着一则广告。

source: You suddenly realize that isn't ink, and step away. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你突然意识到那并不是墨水，赶紧退开。（拒绝任务）

source: You take a closer look at the carts.
translation: 仔细看看那些货车。

source: You take a moment to look over the board.
translation: 停下来看看告示板。

source: You walk away, having your own goals in mind already. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你已有自己的打算，转身离开。（拒绝任务）

source: "A focused mind receives great rewards. Focus on defeating 3 $(enemy_2)s, and be rewarded."
translation: “专注者必有厚报。专心击败 3 个 $(enemy_2)，即可获得奖励。”

source: "Well done." You turn quickly to find a Djinn floating behind you. "You have demonstrated great focus." A collection of treasures float over to you from his outstretched hand.
translation: “干得好。”你猛地转身，发现一个巨灵飘在身后。“你的专注令人赞赏。”他伸出手，一批宝物朝你浮来。

source: "What else was I going to do? Go save the world?" (Accept Quest)
translation: “不然还能干什么？去拯救世界吗？”（接受任务）

source: "What for, indeed?" (Decline Quest)
translation: “是啊，图什么呢？”（拒绝任务）

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: A Focused Mind
translation: 心无旁骛

source: A job board has been constructed outside the local inn, and you see that it is covered in various papers and posters.
translation: 当地旅店外立着一块委托告示板，上面贴满了各式纸张和海报。

source: A short note is written in blue ink.
translation: 一张短笺上写着蓝色字迹。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat $(enemy_2)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_2)

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_2)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_2)。

source: Leave
translation: 出城

source: Leave town to begin your quest.
translation: 离开城镇，开始任务。

source: Most of the ads are nondescript, weather worn, or written in an unfamiliar language. A few catch your eye, however.
translation: 大多数告示不是平平无奇，就是饱经风吹日晒，或是用你不认识的语言写成。不过，还是有几张引起了你的注意。

source: No sooner than you do, the Djinn disappears in a puff of smoke. When you turn back, the $(enemy_2) you just defeated has vanished as well.
translation: 你刚接过东西，巨灵便化作一缕烟雾消失了。再转过头，刚被你击败的 $(enemy_2) 也已不见。

source: One way to find out. (Accept Quest)
translation: 想知道，试试就行。（接受任务）

source: Sometimes it pays to specialize. Cash in on a local bounty by bringing in the remains of 3 $(enemy_2)s. They can usually be found in the Island biome.
translation: 专精一种猎物，有时也能赚钱。带回 3 个 $(enemy_2) 的遗骸，领取当地赏金。通常可在海岛地区找到它们。

source: Warily take the items.
translation: 小心地接过物品。

source: Was this all a test of some sort? (+3 Local Reputation) (Complete Quest)
translation: 这一切难道是某种考验？（当地声望 +3）（完成任务）

source: With no further information listed, you doubt this is actually worth your time. (Decline Quest)
translation: 没有更多说明，你怀疑这事根本不值得花时间。（拒绝任务）

source: You decide you have better things to do than hunt $(enemy_2)s, and you scratch this entry out of your logbook. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你觉得还有比猎杀 $(enemy_2) 更重要的事，于是把这一项从任务日志中划掉了。（当地声望 -2）

source: You look at what seems to be an advertisement of some sort off to one side.
translation: 你望向一旁，那里似乎贴着一则广告。

source: You read the note: '3 $(enemy_2)s? What for?'
translation: 你读着字条：“3 个 $(enemy_2)？图什么？”

source: You take a moment to look over the board.
translation: 停下来看看告示板。

source: You walk away, having your own goals in mind already. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你已有自己的打算，转身离开。（拒绝任务）

source: "And if I bring in six?" (Accept Quest)
translation: “那要是我带回六个呢？”（接受任务）

source: "And what are you hunting, exactly?"
translation: “你们到底在猎什么？”

source: "Keep the loot coming and you won't find another $(enemy_1) on its feet again." (Accept Quest)
translation: “只要报酬不断，我保证不让 $(enemy_1) 站着回来。”（接受任务）

source: "On second thought, I have better things to do." (Decline Quest)
translation: “想了想，我还有更重要的事。”（拒绝任务）

source: "That's awfully ambiguous. Why don't I come back when you have an actual offer?" (Decline Quest)
translation: “这说得也太含糊了。等你们开出实价，我再来吧？”（拒绝任务）

source: "Then you will have brought down too many. We're thinning them, not removing them."
translation: “那就太多了。我们是要减少数量，不是赶尽杀绝。”

source: "What's the bounty?"
translation: “赏金多少？”

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: A haggard and tired looking elf puts down his bow at the door of the tavern. Another elf calls out to him. "Long day's hunt?"
translation: 一个面容憔悴、满脸倦意的精灵在酒馆门边放下弓。另一位精灵招呼道：“又猎了一整天？”

source: As his friend shakes his head with a hint of mirth, you decide to speak up. "I could handle some of them for you."
translation: 他的朋友带着一丝笑意摇摇头，你于是开口：“我可以替你们解决一些。”

source: As promised, the village pays well, by way of their gamekeeper. "The bounty of nature is priceless, but keeping populations in check increases the bounty of all goods." (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 村子的猎场看守信守承诺，给了你丰厚报酬。“自然的馈赠无价，但控制种群，能让万物都更丰饶。”（当地声望 +3）

source: Bored with the conversation already, you finish your meal and leave. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你已经听腻了，吃完饭便离开。（拒绝任务）

source: Both elves turn to face you before they move to a table to continue their conversation more privately. It appears that your interjection was undesired. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 两位精灵一起转头看你，随后换到一张桌边，压低声音继续交谈。看来他们并不欢迎你插话。（当地声望 -1）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat $(enemy_1)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_1)

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。

source: He continues, "There's just too many $(enemy_1)s for the area to sustain. We need to thin their numbers, but there's always more. I don't suppose you've learned to aim?"
translation: 他接着说：“$(enemy_1) 太多了，这片地方养不起。我们得减少它们的数量，可总也猎不完。你该不会连瞄准都还没学会吧？”

source: He thinks for a moment. "Let's start with three as a trial. And we will pay well for them, as I doubt you're doing this for the village."
translation: 他想了想。“先来三个，算是试试身手。我们会给足报酬，毕竟我猜你不是为了村子才出力。”

source: Mind your own business from there. (Decline Quest)
translation: 不再多管闲事。（拒绝任务）

source: Obviously annoyed at the pointless distraction, the two return to their conversation without you. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 两人显然被这番无谓打扰惹烦了，不再理你，继续交谈。（当地声望 -1）

source: Perhaps paying attention could be useful.
translation: 听一听，也许会有用。

source: Population Control
translation: 控制数量

source: Return to the hunter and report your success.
translation: 回到猎人身边，报告任务完成。

source: Sometimes it pays to specialize. Cash in on a local bounty by bringing in the remains of 3 $(enemy_1)s. They can usually be found in the Forest biome.
translation: 专精一种猎物，有时也能赚钱。带回 3 个 $(enemy_1) 的遗骸，领取当地赏金。通常可在森林地区找到它们。

source: The hunter turns his attention to you and looks you over. It's most likely a formality, he would have sized you up coming in the door. "I'll take you up on that."
translation: 猎人把目光转向你，上下打量一番。多半只是做做样子，你进门时他恐怕就已看清了。“那我就不客气了。”

source: The newcomer simply nods and slumps into a chair for a moment before actually replying. "Yes, and more of them to come."
translation: 来者只是点点头，瘫坐在椅子里，过了一会儿才回答：“是啊，后面还得忙上好多天。”

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: You decide you have better things to do than hunt $(enemy_1)s, and you scratch this entry out of your logbook. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你觉得还有比猎杀 $(enemy_1) 更重要的事，于是把这一项从任务日志中划掉了。（当地声望 -2）

source: You don't especially feel like volunteering to take on a $(enemy_1) today. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你今天并不想主动去招惹 $(enemy_1)。（拒绝任务）

source: You nod and prepare to leave. (Continue)
translation: 你点点头，准备离开。（继续）

source: You wait for one of them to say more.
translation: 等其中一人继续说下去。

source: You're not a part of the conversation, so you tune it out. (Decline Quest)
translation: 这不是你的谈话，你也懒得听。（拒绝任务）

source: "And how will you prove it, Sir Kallus?"
translation: “那你打算如何证明，卡勒斯爵士？”

source: "Are $(enemy_1)s so despised around here?"
translation: “这里的人这么讨厌 $(enemy_1) 吗？”

source: "Are you worthy of being trained as a squire of Sir Kallus. Do you believe yourself to be?"
translation: “接受卡勒斯爵士训练、成为其侍从的资格。你认为自己有吗？”

source: "Are you worthy, citizen?" A heavily armored soldier stands at the center of the town square and is occasionally calling out at bypassers. "Are YOU?", he calls out to another one.
translation: “市民，你够资格吗？”一个身披重甲的士兵站在镇中心的广场上，不时朝路人喊话。“那么，你呢？”他又叫住另一个人。

source: "Are you?"
translation: “你是吗？”

source: "Challenge accepted." (Accept Quest)
translation: “我接受挑战。”（接受任务）

source: "Go on. Off with you!" (Continue)
translation: “去吧，快去！”（继续）

source: "Good!" You nod. "I'm glad we've established that."
translation: “很好！”你点点头，“总算说清楚了。”

source: "I am not interested." (Decline Quest)
translation: “我没兴趣。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I mean are you worthy, Sir Kallus?"
translation: “我的意思是，卡勒斯爵士，你够资格吗？”

source: "I shall do the same as I ask of you. Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s. Once I finish, I will return here and wait for you."
translation: “我会做我要求你做的同一件事：击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。完成之后，我会回来等你。”

source: "I'll let you know if I think of anyone." (Decline Quest)
translation: “想到合适的人，我会告诉你的。”（拒绝任务）

source: "No." (Decline Quest)
translation: “不。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Sir Kallus, of course!"
translation: “当然是卡勒斯爵士！”

source: "That was purely hypothetical. I am not worthy, and will be leaving now." (Decline Quest)
translation: “我只是打个比方。我不够资格，这就告辞了。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Then good day to you, Sir Kallus." (Decline Quest)
translation: “那么，祝您愉快，卡勒斯爵士。”（拒绝任务）

source: "There. You're solving your own problems. Now get out of here." (Decline Quest)
translation: “看，这不就自己解决了吗。现在快去吧。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Who are you?"
translation: “你是谁？”

source: "Who is Sir Kallus?"
translation: “卡勒斯爵士是谁？”

source: "Worthy of what, exactly?"
translation: “什么资格？”

source: "You look worthy. I believe you are. Are you?"
translation: “看你像是够资格。我认为你是。你是吗？”

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat $(enemy_1)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_1)

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。

source: He blinks several times, then resumes the conversation on his terms. "Will you accept my challenge to defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s?"
translation: 他眨了几次眼，又把话题拉了回去。“你愿意接受我的挑战，击败 3 个 $(enemy_1) 吗？”

source: He laughs as if the question was ridiculous. "I am, of course. And I need someone to prove that they are worthy of my teachings!"
translation: 他笑了起来，仿佛这个问题荒唐至极。“当然是我！我需要有人证明，自己配得上我的教导！”

source: He looks at you again, as though he hadn't actually paid attention to you before. "Then you prove it. Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s with honor."
translation: 他又看了你一眼，像是刚才根本没注意你。“那就证明它。光明正大地击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。”

source: He looks at you with a hint of frustration. "Yes, I am Sir Kallus."
translation: 他有些不耐烦地看着你。“是的，我就是卡勒斯爵士。”

source: He thinks for a moment, clearly working through this. "I must be worthy of myself! I am! I am and I shall prove it."
translation: 他认真琢磨了一会儿。“我必须配得上我自己！我是够资格的！是的，我会证明！”

source: His brow furrows, not accustomed to being spoken to in such a manner. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他皱起眉头，显然不习惯别人这样对他说话。（当地声望 -1）

source: One of the merchants laughs. "No, but Sir Kallus is. And since you left, we haven't seen him. Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts." (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 一个商人笑了。“不，讨厌的是卡勒斯爵士。你走后，我们就再没见过他。真心谢谢你。”（当地声望 +3）

source: Proving Yourself Worthy
translation: 证明你的资格

source: Return to where the quest began to turn in the reagents and collect your rewards.
translation: 回到接取任务的地方，交付材料并领取报酬。

source: Sir Kallus isn't worth you being worthy of him. You scratch this item out of your notes. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 卡勒斯爵士还不值得你费力去配得上他。你把这件事从笔记里划掉了。（当地声望 -2）

source: Sometimes it pays to specialize. Cash in on a local bounty by bringing in the remains of 3 $(enemy_1)s. They can usually be found in the Plains biome.
translation: 专精一种猎物，有时也能赚钱。带回 3 个 $(enemy_1) 的遗骸，领取当地赏金。通常可在平原地区找到它们。

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: You approach the man, curious.
translation: 你好奇地走向他。

source: You decide to humor him. "Let's say that I am, what then?"
translation: 你决定顺着他的话说。“就算是吧，然后呢？”

source: You return to town, and see no sign of Sir Kallus. Instead, the merchants from the shops near the town square rush over to give you a hero's welcome and rewards of their own.
translation: 你回到镇上，却没见到卡勒斯爵士。反倒是广场附近的商人们一拥而上，像欢迎英雄一样迎接你，还纷纷送上自己的谢礼。

source: You shake your head and keep walking, uninterested in whatever this is. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你摇摇头，继续走路，对这事毫无兴趣。（拒绝任务）

source: Your flat answer seems to stun him for a moment until another person walks into the square. He begins to call out to them, and he forgets you exist.
translation: 你干脆的回答让他愣了片刻。直到另一个人走进广场，他又开始叫喊，转眼就把你忘了。

source: "...but it's for SCIENCE!!!" A young woman leaves the tavern in a hurry, with someone yelling at her back from the other side of the doorway. A dwarf in a labcoat with goggles on his head comes shuffling after.
translation: “……可这是为了科学！！！”一个年轻女人匆匆离开酒馆，门内有人对着她的背影大喊。随后，一个穿实验服、头顶护目镜的矮人拖着步子追了出来。

source: "Aha! I have it! I still need to investigate the internal structure of $(enemy_1)s. I think they can be found in this area. Can you bring me some? Mostly intact?"
translation: “啊哈！有了！我还没研究过 $(enemy_1) 的内部结构。我想这附近应该找得到。能替我带几个来吗？尽量完整些？”

source: "Another time perhaps, I need to keep moving." (Decline Quest)
translation: “改天吧，我还得赶路。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I can do that." (Accept Quest)
translation: “这个可以。”（接受任务）

source: "It really depends on what they are." You look at him suspiciously.
translation: 你怀疑地看着他。“那得看是什么实验。”

source: "Sorry, I just decided that I'm more into magic than science." (Decline Quest)
translation: “抱歉，我刚决定，自己还是更喜欢魔法，不喜欢科学。”（拒绝任务）

source: "You're not a farmhand, so it will have to be." He thinks for a moment, pulling out a well worn notebook and flipping through the pages.
translation: “你又不是农场帮工，那就只能……”他想了想，掏出一本翻得很旧的笔记，开始逐页查找。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat $(enemy_1)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_1)

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。

source: In the Name of Science
translation: 以科学之名

source: It's none of your business, keep moving. (Decline Quest)
translation: 不关你的事，继续赶路。（拒绝任务）

source: Return to where the quest began to turn in the reagents and collect your rewards.
translation: 回到接取任务的地方，交付材料并领取报酬。

source: Sometimes it pays to specialize. Cash in on a local bounty by bringing in the remains of 3 $(enemy_1)s. They can usually be found in the Wasteland biome.
translation: 专精一种猎物，有时也能赚钱。带回 3 个 $(enemy_1) 的遗骸，领取当地赏金。通常可在荒地地区找到它们。

source: The dwarf makes no effort to stop you. He seems so lost in his notes that he may not have even heard you.
translation: 矮人没拦你。他埋头翻看笔记，可能压根没听见。

source: The scientist can find his $(enemy_1)s to experiment on some other way, you're done with this. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 让那位科学家另想办法找 $(enemy_1) 做实验吧，你不干了。（当地声望 -2）

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: With little hope of catching the damsel, he turns his attention to you. "Can I interest you in assisting me with some scientific experiments?"
translation: 见追不上那位姑娘，他把目光转向你。“有兴趣协助我做些科学实验吗？”

source: You leave while you can. (Continue)
translation: 趁现在还能走，赶紧离开。（继续）

source: You observe the scene as it develops before you.
translation: 站在一旁，看看会发生什么。

source: You try to talk to him, but the dwarf is completely lost in his work already. You take the bundle he was carrying, assuming it to be your rewards. (Complete Quest)
translation: 你想和他说两句话，他却已完全沉浸在工作里。你拿起他带来的包裹，姑且当作自己的报酬。（完成任务）

source: You wait to see what he comes up with.
translation: 等着看他会想出什么。

source: You walk back into the town with the requested cargo of $(enemy_1)s. You're unsure if they will be useful, but the dwarf seems extremely excited to begin his work. (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 你带着对方要求的 $(enemy_1) 回到镇上。你不确定它们是否有用，但矮人已兴奋得迫不及待，准备开始研究。（当地声望 +3）

source: "I'll file that away under things that make sense yet don't." (Decline Quest)
translation: “这可真是既说得通、又说不通。我记下了。”（拒绝任务）

source: "I'm not sure I want to meet 3 $(enemy_1)s. Or the shaman, for that matter." (Decline Quest)
translation: “我不太想碰上 3 个 $(enemy_1)。那位祭师也一样。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Seems simple enough" (Accept Quest)
translation: “看起来挺简单。”（接受任务）

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Complete Quest)
translation: （完成任务）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: A job board has been constructed outside the local inn, and you see that it is covered in various papers and posters.
translation: 当地旅店外立着一块委托告示板，上面贴满了各式纸张和海报。

source: A short note is written in red ink.
translation: 一张短笺上写着红色字迹。

source: At the request of a village shaman, defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s. They can usually be found in the Mountain biome.
translation: 应村中祭师之请，击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。通常可在山脉地区找到它们。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat $(enemy_1)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_1)

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。

source: Find the shaman and collect your rewards.
translation: 找到祭师，领取报酬。

source: Having spent as much time searching for $(enemy_1)s as you care to, you scratch this item out of your notes. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你已经不想再花时间寻找$(enemy_1)了，于是划掉了笔记上的这条委托。（当地声望 -2）

source: It reads: "Gimgee's rocks. When you need a good rock, think Gimgee's."
translation: 上面写着：“金吉石头。需要好石头，就想金吉。”

source: Most of the ads are nondescript, weather worn, or written in an unfamiliar language. A few catch your eye, however.
translation: 大多数告示不是平平无奇，就是饱经风吹日晒，或是用你不认识的语言写成。不过，还是有几张引起了你的注意。

source: Shamanic Totems
translation: 祭师的图腾

source: The note says "{COLOR=red}Wanted: 3 $(enemy_1)s. Dead. Contact town shaman for reward.{ENDCOLOR}"
translation: 字条上写着：“{COLOR=red}悬赏：3 个 $(enemy_1)，要死的。请找镇上祭师领取报酬。{ENDCOLOR}”

source: The village shaman grins as you enter their tent. "Yes, this is good. This is good. The spirits have been satisfied." (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 你走进帐篷，村里的祭师咧嘴笑了。“好，很好。灵魂们满意了。”（当地声望 +3）

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: You look at what seems to be an advertisement of some sort off to one side.
translation: 你望向一旁，那里似乎贴着一则广告。

source: You take a moment to look over the board.
translation: 停下来看看告示板。

source: You walk away, having your own goals in mind already. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你已有自己的打算，转身离开。（拒绝任务）

source: "DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? ARE YOU THE BEST IN SHANDALAR???" A young girl yells at the top of her lungs at each passer by in the town. Most people come into view already covering their ears, having heard this plenty of times before.
translation: “你有这个本事吗？你是山德拉最强的人吗？？？”镇上一个小女孩扯着嗓子，朝每个过路人喊叫。大多数人早已听过无数遍，还没走近，就已经捂住了耳朵。

source: "HEY THAT'S MINE!!!" She finds her full ear-piercing volume again before pulling it away and reading. "PROVE YOU'RE THE BEST IN THE ARENA! THE TOURNAMENT BEGINS SOON"
translation: “喂，那是我的！！！”她又恢复了刺耳的嗓门，一把夺回纸张，念道：“在竞技场证明你才是最强者！锦标赛即将开始！”

source: "No thanks, I think I'll go find somewhere quiet for a while." (Decline Quest)
translation: “不了，谢谢。我想找个安静地方待会儿。”（拒绝任务）

source: "Okay, sure, going somewhere far away seems good right now." (Accept Quest)
translation: “好，好。现在能离这里远点就不错。”（接受任务）

source: "That's a little further than I'm looking to travel right now. But thanks all the same." (Decline Quest)
translation: “这比我眼下想走的路远了些。不过还是谢谢。”（拒绝任务）

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: (Complete Quest)
translation: （完成任务）

source: (continue)
translation: （继续）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Arena
translation: 竞技场

source: As you walk through the $(poi_1) gates, you can feel the excitement building, emanating, radiating from the city's arena. Most of the populace is already there or on their way.
translation: 走过 $(poi_1) 的城门，你能感到一股激动的气氛从竞技场向整座城蔓延。大多数居民已经到了，或正在赶去的路上。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Cover your ears and move away quickly.
translation: 捂住耳朵，赶紧走开。

source: Cover your own ears and keep walking (Decline Quest)
translation: 捂住耳朵，继续走路。（拒绝任务）

source: Enter and win an upcoming arena event.
translation: 参加即将举行的竞技场赛事，并赢得胜利。

source: Eternal Glory
translation: 永恒的荣耀

source: Heart of a Champion
translation: 冠军之心

source: It would be a shame to keep the crowd waiting for their new champion.
translation: 可不能让观众久等他们的新冠军。

source: Make your way to the $(poi_1).
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)。

source: Prove yourself to be the champion of the $(poi_1) arena.
translation: 在 $(poi_1) 的竞技场证明你是冠军。

source: She looks at you blankly for a moment, then resumes shouting into the air. "DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? ARE YOU THE BEST IN SHANDALAR???"
translation: 她茫然地看了你片刻，又开始对着空中大喊：“你有这个本事吗？你是山德拉最强的人吗？？？”

source: She looks surprised, and falls silent for a moment as she tries to remember what to do next. "I uhhh... ummm..." She pulls a piece of paper out of her pocket and prepares to read.
translation: 她吃了一惊，安静片刻，努力回想下一步该做什么。“我，呃……那个……”她从口袋里掏出一张纸，准备照着念。

source: She reads over the paper as if seeing this part of it for the first time. "It says here... 'Go to... $(poi_1)... and compete for prizes.' Do you know how to get there?"
translation: 她看着纸，像是头一次读到这一段。“上面说……‘前往……$(poi_1)……参加比赛，赢取奖品。’你知道怎么去吗？”

source: Take the paper from her.
translation: 从她手里拿过纸。

source: The $(poi_1) arena is too much for you at the moment, but there's always another day. (-2 Reputation in $(poi_1))
translation: $(poi_1) 的竞技场眼下还不是你能征服的地方，不过来日方长。（$(poi_1) 声望 -2）

source: The crowd goes wild as you finish your last opponent. You won't be paying for drinks in the $(poi_1) for quite some time. (+3 Reputation in $(poi_1))
translation: 最后一名对手倒下时，观众欢声雷动。看来很长一段时间里，你在 $(poi_1) 喝酒都不用付钱了。（$(poi_1) 声望 +3）

source: The presence of so many powerful spellcasters has the air filled with traces of mana.
translation: 众多强大施法者齐聚，让空气中充满了法术力的余韵。

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Wait for her to continue.
translation: 等她继续说。

source: You walk over to her. "Okay, kid, settle down, I heard you. What's this about?"
translation: 你走到她面前。“好了，孩子，小声点，我听到了。到底什么事？”

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）
